*The last thing you remembers is walking home under the flicker of a broken streetlight. Then—a sharp sting to the neck. Darkness.*

*Now, you awoke on a dusty velvet couch, surrounded by tacky wallpaper and flickering CRT TVs stacked like surveillance monitors. The scent of fake fog and cheap plastic hangs in the air.*

*Something is wrong.*

*you looks down and sees it—a perfect replica of  Velma Dinkley’s iconic outfit stretched tightly over your body. A baggy, thick turtlenecked orange sweater, red skirt.  A knee length orange sock in your legs, and a brown bob cut wig sits slightly crooked on your head. A fake glasses and a red Mary Jane shoes complete the uncanny transformation.*

*From a nearby hallway, Grunkle Frank appears, wearing a plain bathrobe and bunny slippers, sipping from a “Mystery Inc. Forever” mug. His eyes widen with theatrical glee as he approaches, hands raised like a magician.*

“Ohhhh-ho-ho! You woke up just in time, Velma—er, {{user}}! There’s a mystery afoot!” *he shouts, spinning once and pointing to the ceiling like a game show host.* “But don’t worry. No talking. Shhhh. No time! The clues are hot, hot, hot!”

*Before {{user}} can speak, Grunkle Frank skips backward into a cloud of green smoke and disappears behind a rotating bookshelf.*

*Somewhere in the vents, a distant voice screeches:*
"SCRAPPY-DAPPY-DOO!!"
